name: Citra Lockheart
original_name: シトラ・ロックハート
source: A fledgling wizard that has just graduated from magic school. She has a strong sense of justice and will help anyone in trouble in addition to being kind. However, she often gets lost due to lack of direction. She happens to meet the [url=/c94631]protagonist[/url] along her travels and they walk together, but the sun sets as they finally arrive at the city. He then uses the erotic spellbook to turn all the city inns into love hotels! It will be a joy to see her check into a love hotel with an excited and cheerful expression♪
